item.title: NM State Fair board agrees to spend $114M on housing, stadium
item.description: Under the new master plan the board adopted, a corner of the fairgrounds property will make way for new housing, a stadium and a public park.

item.title: New Mexico, Meta make closing arguments to jury over case alleging harm to state’s youth
item.description: In closing arguments Monday, New Mexico prosecutors beseeched a Santa Fe jury to award more than $2 billion for the damage the state says social media giant Meta inflicted on the state’s teen users of the company’s social media platforms, violating the state's consumer protection laws.

item.title: Feds conduct low-level flights to scan southern, central New Mexico geology
item.description: Starting last week, the U.S. Geological Service began conducting low-lying flights over portions of seven New Mexico counties to produce advanced maps of their possible mineral deposits and help reveal what else is below ground. The flights form part of the federal Earth MRI program, which was established in 2019 to boost high-quality geological data to map out the country’s mineral deposits, geothermal activity, water supplies and help mitigate earthquakes or landslides.

item.title: NM Supreme Court upholds judge’s decision to toss challenge to Duke Rodriguez gubernatorial campaign

item.title: New Mexico officials, tribes accuse feds of rushing efforts to reverse Chaco Canyon drilling ban
item.description: The Trump administration, for the last year, has floated a proposal to reverse a Biden-era order that issued a 20-year ban on oil and gas development on federal lands within 10 miles of the site, which holds paramount spiritual and cultural significance for numerous tribes and pueblos.

item.title: New Mexico Republicans seek legislative committee on fraud, waste, abuse
item.description: Every Republican in the New Mexico state Senate on Tuesday co-signed a letter requesting an interim legislative committee focused on vetting allegations of fraud, waste and abuse in state government.
